questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

35 × 16 + 3 ÷ 156 - 12 = ?

‘A × B’ means ‘A is B’s mother’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is B’s son’.

‘A + B’ means ‘A is B’s husband’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is B’s sister’.

Using the same meaning of the mathematical operators as given above, in ‘D + E × F – G’ what is the relation of F with D?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 ÷
 +
 –
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Son
 Husband
 Sister
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: D + E × F – G

D + E → D is the husband of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a73a111f699da6926025cc1a5576c7ffaf51955ae46fa3140a5a2bb312f6d69.png] 

E × F → E is the mother of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51c967be0d1d527d0e37fa0b6b7076e243aae8266e39f580e9c20eb418024791.png] 

F – G → F is the sister of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8720f7755b77b5e4c5a7b9a18faa9fd2f791d8f1b38a9ec2ce3f8a86260e089.png] 

Thus, F is D's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question:
13 is related to 39 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 25 is related to 75. To which of the following is 42 related following the same logic?

(**NOTE : **Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 3) = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 13 : 39

⇒ (13 × 3) = 39.

For, 25 : 75

⇒ (25 × 3) = 75.

Similarly, for 42 ∶ ?

**⇒ (42 × 3) = 126.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If 05 August 2005 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 April 2011?
questions.solution:
Given: **05 August 2005** was Friday.

Now,

2005 to 2011 = 6 Years (5 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 6 Years = 1 Leap Year and 5 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 5 Ordinary Years have 5 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 5 = 7.

7 odd

questions.question:
If 'A' stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for, '-' what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

45 B 6 D 78 A 3 C 15 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 45 B 6 D 78 A 3 C 15 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 45 × 6 - __**78 ÷ 3**__ + 15 = ?

⇒ __**45 × 6**__ - 26 + 15 = ?

⇒ __270__ - 26 __**+ 15**__ = ?

⇒ __285** - 26**__ = **259**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements :**

Some rivers are huts.

All streams are grass.

Some grass are rivers.

**Conclusion (I) : **All grass are streams.

**Conclusion (II) : **Some grass are huts.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/824b9e6d7e0c910993874ba9c4008057ab30e869fc362f873e6752f8d07a1d05.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All grass are streams → Does not follow (As all streams are grass. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some grass are huts → Does not follow (As some rivers are huts and some grass are rivers. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"

⇒ 112 + 14 = 126

**⇒ 96 + 14 = 110**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
